test_title: PYST 8: SSC CHSL - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Simple interest and compound interest (Compounding annually) on a principal at a certain rate of interest for 2 years is Rs. 1600 and Rs. 1760 respectively. What is the principle?
solution:
Given:

Time(T) = 2 years

Simple interest(SI) = Rs. 1600

Compound interest(CI) = Rs. 1760

Formula used:

SI = dfrac{P times R times T}{100}

P = Principal

Difference between SI and CI for 2 years = Interest on SI of first year

Calculation:

SI for 1 year = 1600/2 = Rs. 800

Difference between SI and CI = 1760 - 1600 = Rs. 160

Rate of interest(R) = (160/800) × 100 = 20%

According to the question:

800 = dfrac{P times 20 times 1}{100}

⇒ P = 4000

∴ Principal = Rs. 4000

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** Formula used:

CI/SI = 1 +r/200 ( This is formula used for only two year)

1760/1600 = 1 +r/200

r = 20%

SI for 1 year = 1600/2 = Rs. 800

800 = dfrac{P times 20 times 1}{100}

⇒ P = 4000
